purpose: Correct canonical reference anatomy, not generate another animation pose.

input_link.verification: Actual PNG exists in isolated worktree, decoded/hash checked, viewed directly; tool schema accepts absolute local image paths as editing references. No separate server ingestion receipt exposed.
input_link.other_images: Historical A/B inspected for context only; rejected capture poses not used.

mask.application: Pinned sprites-post deterministic masked replacement after generation; no mask input API claimed.

anatomical_mapping.left: Far/upper head away from observer; shorten neck while preserving head size.
anatomical_mapping.right: Near/lower-right head closest to observer; reconstruct own connected neck.
anatomical_mapping.middle: Preserve existing identity, skull and connection as far as feasible.
anatomical_mapping.depth: Retain occlusion order; do not make all heads/neck paths visible for emphasis.

technical_choice: Generative local correction because neck tissue/root anatomy must be drawn; rigid movement alone does not reconstruct it. Mask protects torso/legs/tail and global body placement.
